description: Create a TouchDesigner Base COMP that converts hand landmarks into a stable gesture-control Null CHOP for palm holograms, lasers, audio controls, and other hand-reactive visuals. It creates helper nodes under parent_path, returns the component/output paths and created-node report, and exposes debounced channels such as palm_open, float_x/y, palm_size, pinch_active, pinch_power, scale_target, light_gain, and audio_level. Use source='synthetic' for camera-free previews, source='mediapipe' to build/use setup_hand_tracking, or source='existing_chop' with hand_chop_path when a hand landmark CHOP already exists.

active_hand_lock.description: Keep the first active hand as the control hand until it is lost, reducing hand switching.

adapter_name.description: Name for the setup_hand_tracking adapter when source='mediapipe'.

comp_name.description: Name for the created gesture-bus Base COMP under parent_path.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate family expected from the hand source: normalized image space or world space.

expose_controls.description: Create custom parameters on the component for tuning smoothing, pinch, and lock behavior.

fast_smoothing.description: Fast smoothing factor for responsive pinch/power channels; higher values move more slowly.

hand_chop_path.description: Required only when source='existing_chop'; path to a CHOP with hand landmark channels.

hold_seconds.description: Seconds a disappearing/open palm is held before channels fall back.

max_hands.description: Number of hands to track or synthesize; the gesture bus supports one or two hands.

mirror.description: Mirror X coordinates for front-facing camera interaction and synthetic previews.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the gesture-bus component and helper nodes are created.

pinch_arm_seconds.description: Seconds pinch_active must remain close before it is considered armed.

pinch_close_dist.description: Thumb-index distance at or below which a pinch closes; must be less than pinch_open_dist.

pinch_open_dist.description: Thumb-index distance at or above which a pinch opens; must be greater than pinch_close_dist.

pinch_radius.description: Palm-local radius around the pinch point used to estimate pinch_power.

pinch_radius_scale.description: Multiplier applied to pinch_radius when converting distance into pinch_power.

pinch_threshold.description: Normalized pinch_power threshold used to expose binary pinch_active channels.

smoothing.description: Slow smoothing factor for stable palm/float channels; higher values move more slowly.

source.description: Input source: synthetic preview data, a new MediaPipe adapter, or an existing hand CHOP.

tox_path.description: Optional MediaPipe adapter .tox path passed through when source='mediapipe'.

name: create_hand_gesture_bus
title: Create hand gesture bus
